provenance: The generated tabletop scene illustrates the task. A separate one-head model uses 4×4 grayscale grids and two-number rows: we inspect its starting weights, then train all 44 parameters on two grids. LayerNorm and the feed-forward sublayer appear in the full ViT architecture after the numerical worksheet. Everything runs offline.
